Class AALine

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AAObject
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AALine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AALine extends AAObject implements Serializable
Representation of a line object in an area display. Contains the parameters needed to display the object as a "polyline" in the display that connects a specified set of x,y points in the area display.

ModelerOne
